title: CSCI 452 — Systems Programming
subject: Computer Systems
description: An independent, catalog-aligned learning companion. It is not an official RIT course section or a replacement for the instructor's syllabus.
outcomes: Define the operational boundaries between user mode and privileged kernel mode in a multiprogramming environment.
Explain how system calls and traps transfer control from user code to kernel services while preserving processor state.
Apply hardware interface design principles by mapping virtual addresses to physical memory using page tables and managing concurrent access with locks
